Get Forms.description: Lists all survey forms the authorized user can access.

Get Form Submissions.description: Fetches submissions for a single form.

Get New Submissions Since Last Sync.description: Fetches only submissions received after the last successful run.

Get All Submissions.description: Downloads every submission for a form, with no limit.
Get All Submissions.code:
// Download all submissions for a form (by default the adaptor stops at 30,000).
getSubmissions($.configuration.formId, { limit: Infinity });

Get Latest Submissions.description: Fetches the most recent submissions first.

Filter Submissions By Answer.description: Fetches submissions matching a question value, using a MongoDB-style query.

Get Form Deployment Info.description: Fetches deployment details for a form, such as active status and submission count.
Get Form Deployment Info.code:
// Get deployment information for a form.
getDeploymentInfo($.configuration.formId);
